label: first token is j or f (plus sporadic j/f copy-phase inputs)
explanation: Fires almost only when the input token is j or f (about 95% of activation mass). Main mode: j or f as the very first token (t=0). It fires on every such step (precision 1.0 on dev) at a fixed moderate level of about 0.2 of max. This mode holds about 66% of the mass. Second mode: j or f fed back as an input during the copy phase, mostly at recall_idx>=3. It fires on only about 15-30% of those steps, and I found no simple rule for which ones (next_out, to_go, t and in_count gave F1<0.2). These copy-phase hits make up the largest activations (up to max) and most of the top quartile. It does not fire on j/f at original positions 1..L-1, on the delimiter, or on other tokens, apart from rare weak hits on n/e/z right after a copied j/f. Adding the copy-phase clause (j/f at t==0 or in copy with recall_idx>=3) raises mass recall to 0.95 but drops precision to 0.34.
